item.title: Foreign state funds set sights on Euro1bn of Irish property deals
item.author: THE SUNDAY TIMES
item.description: Norges has entered into exclusive talks to buy Cheevers Court & Haliday House, a build-to-rent scheme in Dun Laoghaire, for Euro220m. It was reported by Green Street News that the sale of the 368 apartments was back on, after being paused in the summer. The vendor, DWS, owned by Germany's Deutsche Bank, asked interested parties to resubmit bids last month.
